title: 日本ダービーの後に・瞳に映ったもの

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo laughs triumphantly in the winner's circle after her victory in the Japanese Derby before cutting her moment in the limelight short and running off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems she wanted to distract the reporters from Special Week, who left crying because of her loss.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, King Halo receives a call from her mother, who chastises her behavior and praises Special Week's efforts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since her mother is still unwilling to recognize her skill, King Halo vows to win the final race of the Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho.
